task: 092 Bluetooth GATT readiness after service restart
scope: Independent source review and local tests; no repository edits or hardware mutations
result: Updated source review passed; latest Linux and live acceptance pending

checks.detail: Exact-device typed Connected/ServicesResolved lookup. Reused and error/CLI-assisted connections require Ready; Pending/Unknown on these paths cannot authorize cached complete exports. Successful normal btleplug connect keeps zero added lookup for complete first discovery; missing exports preserve unknown-state fallback only after that successful readiness barrier.
State query, rediscovery and sleep share one absolute deadline. Paused-time tests verify pending futures drop, no zero-budget I/O, early confirmed disconnect and no fixed delay after ready metadata.
Legacy missing-characteristic recovery requires a successful fresh incomplete discovery near deadline with Ready before and after; unconfirmed state uses distinct error detail.

Anchored transient readiness/disconnected prefixes avoid stale-bond classification; explicit org.bluez.Error.AuthenticationFailed detail preserves genuine authentication recovery; generic confirmed encrypted failures retain compatibility.
Real phase regression resets current attempt phase, including reused-link fallback beginning at service discovery. Terminal failure detail is captured separately; failed sentinel is not a real stage.
No image, protocol, status freshness, FFI session ownership or disconnect-listener implementation changes in reviewed diff.

resolved_findings.title: Linux PeripheralId must be restored to absolute BlueZ path
resolved_findings.detail: Pinned btleplug PeripheralId delegates to DeviceId Display and yields hci0/dev_*; initial candidate used that relative identifier for absolute ObjectManager lookup, always returning Unknown. Corrected production wrapper restores /org/bluez/ prefix and Linux test covers the same wrapper with Ready/Pending/wrong-adapter cases. Independently rechecked call-site and pinned Display implementation.

resolved_findings.title: Complete cached GATT exports do not prove readiness after link reuse
resolved_findings.detail: BlueZ 5.82 disconnect clears active GATT backend without removing exported services/characteristics; a reused or CLI-assisted connected link can yield complete discovery while ServicesResolved is false. First complete discovery currently bypasses readiness and may cause false encrypted-write/rebond failure. Gate explicit readiness on reused/connect-error paths, while preserving successful ordinary btleplug connect fast path, which already awaits ServicesResolved.
resolved_findings.resolution: Targeted connection evidence distinguishes reused/error-assisted links from successful btleplug connect. Reused and unconfirmed routes now require explicit Ready before fresh discovery even with complete cached exports; Pending/Unknown cannot authorize the cached table. Successful ordinary connect with complete initial discovery retains no added readiness lookup. Evidence is refreshed after internal reconnect.
resolved_findings.independent_validation: Reviewed initialization and both connect/reconnect call sites; independently executed all fifteen Mac GATT tests, including five added cached-complete/policy cases.
